audit: independent periodic-column IoC target and matched family-wise null
ciphertext_domain: uppercase whitespace-free repository transcription, ASCII bytes

null_design.derived_cases: prepend 0, 1, or 2 zeros; reversal is retained in target count but omitted from null computation because pooled IoC is exactly invariant
null_design.orientation_dependence_limit: the four base-converted orientations are shuffled independently; this is a stated product-conditional null, not a ciphertext-generative model
null_design.replicate_statistic: maximum pooled column IoC across the full 4 orientations x 3 zero counts x 2 reversal labels x periods 1..40 grid for one base
